description: Wave 4E strictly read-only console-only clean-room probe catalog covering yUI 140/ySI, kNVSE 37, UI Organizer 230, MCM XML bitwise math, BaseObjectSwapper, SUP LockPickMenu, JIP Script Runner gx_, and vanilla combat/AI runtime observations.

batches.title: Wave 4E Batch 1 - yUI 140 / ySI & kNVSE 37 Read-Only Probes

probes.claim: ySIGetTrait/ySISetTrait 'string' is an exact alias for 'tag' in yUI 140 (v1.4d), returning only the raw sorting tag and sharing per-form mutation state with 'tag'.
probes.expected: PR #3725 originally formatted '{tag} {name}' for 'string'; yUI 140 returns raw tag and aliases 'string' directly to 'tag'.
script_lines: string_var pA = sv_Construct "10mm:tag=[%z]|str=[%z]; key:tag=[%z]|str=[%z]; doc:tag=[%z]|str=[%z]" t10 s10 tKey sKey tDoc sDoc
string_var pB = sv_Construct "setStr(ret=%g,10T=[%z],10S=[%z],9T=[%z]); setTag(10T=[%z],10S=[%z])" iR1 t10a s10a t9a t10b s10b

probes.claim: ySIGetTrait returns empty string '' for template, systemcolor, category, name, tab, count, and bogus trait names; ySISetTrait returns 0 for template and systemcolor.
probes.expected: yUI 140 implements only tag/string and icon/filename; all 6 metadata trait queries return '' and setters return 0.
script_lines: string_var pA = sv_Construct "10mm(tpl=[%z],sc=[%z],cat=[%z],nm=[%z],tab=[%z],cnt=[%z],bog=[%z])" sTp sSc sCat sNm sTab sCnt sBog
string_var pB = sv_Construct "keyCat=[%z]|set(tpl=%g:[%z],sc=%g:[%z])" kCat rTp sTp2 rSc sSc2

probes.claim: With ySI.json loaded, querying ySIGetTrait 'icon'/'filename' on an unmatched base form or explicit-arg placed world ref returns 'interface\icons\Misc_Unknown.dds'.
probes.expected: Unmatched forms fall back to 'interface\icons\Misc_Unknown.dds' when ySI JSON packs are loaded.

probes.claim: Calling rRef.ySIGetTrait as a dot-receiver unwraps a placed world ref to its base form, whereas passing rRef as explicit 2nd argument does not unwrap it.
Check yUI.ini vs Menus\ySI\ySI.ini bSortingIcons gating of BarterMenu/ySI/_ySI UI injection and independence of ySIGetTrait JSON queries.
probes.expected: ySIGetTrait remains active even when bSortingIcons=0; BarterMenu/ySI/_ySI=1 whenever either yUI.ini or ySI.ini sets bSortingIcons=1.

script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w4e_05_ysi_ini_precedence_and_gating|trait=[%z/%z]|barter(mm=%g,ysi=%g,pip=%g)" svT svF mm fYsi fPip

probes.claim: armorDT acts as a >= N threshold; formlist:2 resolves Brass Knuckles to '(fna1)'; 'icon' and 'filename' share a tag-scoped store propagating to sibling 9mm Pistol.
probes.expected: armorDT(6->zdt05, 12->zdt10, 15->zdt14, 22->zdt20), formlist:2->(fna1), and ySISetTrait 'icon' propagates across sibling forms sharing tag '(fba1)'.
script_lines: string_var pA = sv_Construct "armorDT(lth6=[%z],met12=[%z],cmb15=[%z],pwr22=[%z])|fl2=[%z]" sLth sMet sCmb sPwr sBrs
string_var pB = sv_Construct "sibIcon(10I=[%z],9I=[%z],9F=[%z])" s10I s9I s9F

probes.claim: Compare kNVSE 37 GetAnimCurrentTime and GetAnimationAttributes under sLegacyAnimTimePaths=W4ELegacy,B42Inject for listed vs unlisted animation paths at frequency 1.0 and 2.5.
probes.expected: Immediately after PlayAnimationPath, time/offset/lastTime read -3.40282e+38; after SetAnimSequenceFrequency 2.5 both listed and unlisted paths advance identically by dg*2.5 while offset stays fixed.

script_lines: string_var sA = sv_Construct "t0L=%.5g|t1(l=%.4f,n=%.4f)|dg=%.4f" fT0L fTL1 fTN1 fDg
string_var sB = sv_Construct "leg(t=%.4f,off=%.4f,last=%.4f)|nrm(t=%.4f,off=%.4f,last=%.4f)" fTL2 fOL fLL fTN2 fON fLN

batches.title: Wave 4E Batch 2 - UIO 230, MCM XML Bitwise, BaseObjectSwapper & SUP LockPick
batches.extender: UI Organizer 230 + SUP NVSE 855 + BaseObjectSwapper + JIP LN 57.30

probes.claim: UIO 230 <sin>/<cos>/<ln>/<pow> XML operator results including non-finite <pow> (-2^0.5 -> -nan(ind), 10^400 -> inf).
probes.expected: sin(30)=0.5, cos(60)=0.5, pow(2,3)=8, pow(-2,0.5)=-nan(ind), pow(10,400)=inf; see w4h_03 for nonzero-start <ln> proof.
script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w4e_09_uio_ln_and_pow_nonfinite|sin30=%.4f|cos60=%.4f|lnE=%.4f|lnNeg=%g|ln0=%g|pow23=%g|powNegHalf=%g|powOvf=%g" vS30 vC60 vLnE vLnN vLnZ vP23 vPnh vPov

probes.claim: BaseObjectSwapper gives [References] precedence over [Forms] and resolves duplicate [Forms] rules last-rule-wins on placed container 0x001062C6.
probes.expected: GetBaseObject on 0x001062C6 returns 0x0017B7A1 under both Ref-vs-Form and Multi-Form SWAP INIs.

probes.claim: GetLockPickMenuValue 1 returns lock tier enum (1=Easy for Lock 1/25, 2=Average for 50, 3=Hard for 75, 4=Very Hard for 100), not raw 0/25/50/75/100 thresholds.
probes.expected: Open LockPickMenu (1014): lock1=1.0, lock25=1.0, lock50=2.0 (v2=100.0, v3=0.0), lock75=3.0, lock100=4.0.

batches.title: Wave 4E Batch 3 - Vanilla Combat, HELIOS One Awareness, Script Runner gx_ & Misc Runtime

probes.claim: NVCrRaven (0x00140DB0) and NVCRTumbleweed (0x0016938D) explode torso (IsLimbGone 0 == 1) on KillActor Player 0 0 and explosion death without Bloody Mess, while non-hit DamageAV Health 500 leaves IsLimbGone 0 == 0.
probes.expected: NVCrRaven noBM: dmg(d=1,lg0=0), kill0(d=1,lg0=1); NVCRTumbleweed noBM: kill0(d=1,lg0=1), expl(d=1,lg0=1).

probes.claim: At HELIOS One exterior (0x000CDEFD) with neutral NCR reputation, all 3 CrDogNCRAggressive guard dogs (0xA695F, 0xA695E, 0xA6944) and loaded NCR troopers remain peaceful (IsInCombat=0).
probes.expected: d1/d2/d3 IsInCombat=0, target=00000000, loaded NPCs inCombat=0.

script_lines: PrintToConsole "PROBE|w4e_c08_helios_dogs_peaceful_at_rest|d1(%g,%i)|d2(%g,%i)|d3(%g,%i)|npcs(%g,cmb=%g)" c1 t1 c2 t2 c3 t3 nNpcs nNpcCmb

probes.claim: JIP LN 57.30 Script Runner executes Data\NVSE\Plugins\Scripts\gx_*.txt once on game exit (con_QuitGame) before teardown.
probes.expected: Staged gx_w4e_exit.txt logs PROBE|w4e_c14_script_runner_gx_exit|GX_FIRED_ON_QUIT after PROBE_DONE on con_QuitGame.
